decision: Derive Qubes transport qualification facts directly from spawned qrexec service crash executions, then build and immediately verify the bounded qualification artifact.

independentReviews.preferredApproach: spawned scenario runners feeding the qualification builder directly
independentReviews.reason: A schema-valid hand-built report can prove report logic but cannot prove the crash executions produced the facts. Reusing the actual service process boundary gives causal evidence for before-mutation, post-mutation, post-journal-commit, indeterminate retries, and complete reconciliation.

independentReviews.preferredApproach: isolated durable stores per scenario with actual Ed25519 response verification and bounded facts only
independentReviews.reason: Keeps claim/heartbeat/fail fail-closed after unknown post-mutation death, allows complete reconciliation only from exact durable postconditions, and excludes lease tokens, request MACs, private keys, raw payloads, paths, and stacks from qualification evidence.

independentReviews.preferredApproach: test/qualification-only spawned processes using existing service and crash child entrypoints
independentReviews.reason: Adds no production qrexec round trip, daemon, database, WAL, coordinator mutation, or persistent runtime state. Cost exists only when qualification is executed and reuses existing process-per-call semantics.

alternativesRejected.approach: hand-construct scenario facts in qualification tests
alternativesRejected.reason: Validates schema and digest logic but not causal execution provenance.

alternativesRejected.approach: add production telemetry or crash switches
alternativesRejected.reason: Would expand attack and operational surface for evidence needed only during qualification.

alternativesRejected.approach: introduce a standalone WAL or receipt database
alternativesRejected.reason: Does not create atomicity with MissionQueueStore by itself and widens Slice 1 responsibilities without closing the same crash ambiguity.

qaRequirements: run all six required crash scenarios through spawned qrexec service processes
derive scenario facts from durable MissionQueueStore state, DurableRequestJournal reopen, and actual Ed25519 verification
duplicateMutations must equal zero for every scenario
before-mutation must have no durable effect and retry must execute once
post-claim/heartbeat/fail retry must be attested indeterminate with no second mutation
post-complete retry must reconcile read-only from exact durable terminal state
post-journal-commit retry must replay the committed outcome
build and immediately verify one qualification report per exact Git SHA and runtime fingerprint
keep raw secrets, fencing tokens, payloads, filesystem paths, and stack traces out of the report
failuresLessons: Earlier qualification evidence could be structurally correct while remaining disconnected from the spawned crash execution that was supposed to justify it.
A missing stdout response is not permission to replay a mutation; durable state and journal status determine whether reconciliation is safe.
Exactly-once for claim/heartbeat/fail is not claimed without a shared transactional boundary; fail-closed indeterminate outcomes are safer than causal inference from post-state.
